name: Base Font Manager
author: Skate Rust Engine
description: Picks a packaged .ttf/.otf as the game-wide base font for the HUD and menus, with a text size scale that compensates for the chosen face. Set Font file under this mod in the Mods menu; leave it empty to restore the engine default.

font_file.label: Font file
font_file.description: Package-relative path of a .ttf/.otf under this mod's fonts/ folder (see the in-game overlay for available paths and use forward slashes). Empty restores the engine default font.

scale.label: Text size scale
scale.description: Multiplies every default-font HUD and menu text size so a large or small base font reads comfortably. 1.00 keeps the original sizes.
